step1_analysis.description: This circuit acts as a half-wave active rectifier for a piezoelectric energy harvester, converting low-frequency AC signals to DC. XM1 and XM2 turn on during the negative half-cycle of the input to charge the output node, while XM3 and XM4 act as leakage control or load devices (though they remain mostly off in a standard CMOS implementation due to the PMOS diode connection to ground).

paper_reference.title: Insole Pedometer with Piezoelectric Energy Harvester and 2V Organic Digital and Analog Circuits

rectified_dc_voltage.description: Average DC voltage at the output node

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD=1.8V and 10Hz AC input, XM2 acts as a switch charging OUT to VDD. Vout ≈ VDD - Vdrop.
sky130_expected.reasoning: XM2 pulls OUT to VDD when IN is low. The 1uF load capacitor holds the charge when IN is high.

power_consumption.description: Average power drawn from the supply

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_avg. With a 1MEG load, I_load = 1.8V / 1MEG = 1.8uA. P = 1.8V * 1.8uA = 3.24uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Power is dominated by the load resistor and switching losses at the 10Hz operating frequency.

energy_per_operation.description: Energy consumed or harvested per cycle

sky130_expected.reasoning: The 3J reported in the paper likely refers to the total energy harvested by the pedometer over a long period. The per-cycle energy for this specific circuit is in the microjoule range.

voltage_ripple.description: Peak-to-peak voltage variation at the output

sky130_expected.reasoning: Ripple depends directly on the 1uF load capacitor (reported in paper) and the discharge rate during the OFF half-cycle.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure rectified DC voltage, ripple, and power consumption of the active rectifier with a 10Hz piezoelectric harvester input.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Rectifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 N1 IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUT IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 N1 VSS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUT N1 GND VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VGND GND 0 0
* 10Hz AC input representing piezoelectric harvester
VIN IN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.9 10 0 0)

* 1uF load capacitor as reported in paper
CLOAD OUT 0 1u
RLOAD OUT 0 1MEG

.control
* Transient analysis for 1 second (10 cycles)
tran 1m 1
meas tran vout_dc avg v(out) from=0.5 to=1
meas tran vout_max max v(out) from=0.5 to=1
meas tran vout_min min v(out) from=0.5 to=1
let ripple = vout_max - vout_min
print ripple

meas tran ivdd_avg avg i(VVDD) from=0.5 to=1
let power = -ivdd_avg * 1.8
print power

let energy_per_cycle = power * 0.1
print energy_per_cycle

* DC sweep to observe switching threshold
dc VIN 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc vout_at_0 find v(out) at=0
meas dc vout_at_1_8 find v(out) at=1.8

quit
.endc
